notes.notes:

※ You can still access the game as normal during the update. 

1. Mahjong Academy Is Coming!
Whether you're new to Riichi mahjong or a seasoned player, the Mahjong Academy has something for you!
(1) Self Training: Master the basics or sharpen your skills with targeted lessons.
(2) Practice Match: Compete against AI opponents at various difficulty levels to get ready for Ranked Matches.
Check in daily and start your journey to mahjong mastery!

notes.notes:
1. Introducing Spring Sports Fest Event
Event duration: the end of maintenance on 2025/04/15 (Tue.) - 2025/05/22 (Thu.) 04:59 (UTC+9)

7. Friendly Match Optimizations

(1) The Friendly Match creation interface will be updated to match the layout of the Custom Tournament creation interface.
(2) When creating a regular 4P Friendly Match, players will be able to directly apply Ranked Match rules in the Advanced Rules section.
(3) After the update, regular 4P Hanchan Friendly Matches can be analyzed using the AI Log Analyzer.

8. Avatar Frame & Title Settings Optimization
A new option, "Sync In-Match & Lobby," will be added to the Avatar Frame and Title interface. When this option is checked, your selected Avatar Frame or Title will be synchronized across both the Lobby and in-match screens.
※ This option is unavailable when Random Mode is turned on for Avatar Frames or Titles.

9. New Cumulative Top-Up Benefit
After the update, players with higher cumulative top-up levels will enjoy increased decoration plan limits.
※ For more details, please check the Shop > Currency Bank > Bonuses page.

10. Achievement Difficulty Adjustment
The number of matches required to complete the achievements "Spirit of Attack Lv.2" and "Spirit of Attack Lv.3" will be reduced.

11. Other optimizations.

notes.title: [Event New Mode Description]
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42810873/bb1e01791c0d47392869c42c83447f274db70647.png[/img]Experience the new mode  '17 Steps' in the 'Spring Sports Fest' event! ✨

🔽 Event duration:
The end of maintenance on 2025/4/15 – 2025/5/22 04:59 (UTC+9)

* In this 2-player mahjong game, each player builds a hand by selecting 13 tiles from their 34-tile wall, leaving 21 tiles as leftovers.
* Once both hands are ready, players take turns discarding from their leftovers until someone calls Ron, or both discard 17 tiles, resulting in Ryuukyoku.
* For more details, please check the event page when it goes live.

※ You can still access the game as normal during the update.

1. Introducing the Collab Event Divine Battle in Another World!
Three mahjong prodigies, including Ten Takashi, are suddenly transported to Riichi City, where they challenge Akagi Shigeru at his peak. As a life-or-death mahjong showdown begins, Ten's true motive starts to surface...
Event duration: the end of maintenance on 2025/03/14 (Fri.) - 2025/04/12 (Sat.) 23:59 (UTC+9)
 
2. Introducing the Lantern Fair Limited-Time Event!
The Lantern Fair consists of two parts: Lantern Riddles and Team-Up Bonus.
◆ Lantern Riddles
Event duration: the end of maintenance on 2025/03/14 (Fri.) - 2025/03/21 (Fri.) 11:59 (UTC+9)
Event description: During this event, players can join one of two rounds daily to solve riddles and earn rewards. In each round, the 1st, 10th, 50th, 100th, 200th, 300th, etc., players to correctly solve three riddles will receive a Lucky Token!
◆ Team-Up Bonus
Event duration: the end of maintenance on 2025/03/14 (Fri.) - 2025/04/12 (Sat.) 23:59 (UTC+9)
Event description: During this event, players can purchase the Lucky Lantern Pack to receive Lucky Token x3, 20% Off Outfit Pack Coupon (90 Days) x1. After the purchase, players will be automatically placed into a team. Once the team reaches five members, everyone in the team will receive one Lucky Token as a bonus via in-app email!
※ Please check the event page for more details.
 
3. Introducing the East-West Battle!
Event duration: the end of maintenance on 2025/03/14 (Fri.) - 2025/04/12 (Sat.) 23:59 (UTC+9)
Event description: After joining either the East or West Camp, players can compete in Ranked Matches or 2P Attack-Defense Battles to earn Camp Points for their camp. At the end of the event, players will receive camp ranking rewards and individual ranking rewards via in-app email.
 
4. Akagi & Ten Characters Limited-Time Gacha
Event duration: the end of maintenance on 2025/03/14 (Fri.) - 2025/04/12 (Sat.) 23:59 (UTC+9)
Event description:
Akagi & Ten characters Akagi Shigeru (CV: Hagiwara Masato), Washizu Iwao (CV: Tsukayama Masane), Ten Takashi (CV: Kobayashi Chikahiro) and Harada Katsumi (CV: Kuroda Takaya) will be introduced to Riichi City. Strengthen your ties with them through mahjong matches!
During this period, players can also draw the following collab exclusive decorations: Riichi Animation - Electric Current, Riichi Animation - Zawa Zawa
 
※ Akagi & Ten Gacha pool is split into two categories: a female character pool Soul of Battle (featuring four collab characters and all permanent female characters) and a male character pool Peak of Mahjong (featuring four collab characters and all permanent male characters).

notes.title: 4P Mahjong Legends Tenkaichi Tournament
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42810873/efa0f8da6ad296181536256773cc220c885abbfe.png[/img]Calling all 4P Ranked Match players at 7th Dan or above with linked emails! Step into the spotlight in the 2025 Mahjong Legends!

[Overview]
The third 4P Mahjong Legends is an official match open to players who have achieved 7th Dan or above in 4P Ranked Matches. The Mahjong Legends consists of a preliminary stage and a knockout stage, and the winner will be determined according to the process below.

◆ Preliminary Stage ◆
Table: 4P Ranked Match - Galaxy - Hanchan
Phases: Preliminary Stage 1 (Top 8), Preliminary Stage 2 (Top 8), Preliminary Stage 3 (Top 8), Preliminary Stage 4 (Top 8)

◆ Knockout Stage ◆
Table: Custom Game - Custom Tournament
Phrases: Quarter-finals, Semi-finals, and the Final (Tenkaichi Table)
※ Format of Tenkaichi Tournament: 4P Hanchan Ranked Match.

[Eligibility]
Participants must reach 7th Dan or above in 4P Ranked Matches and have their emails linked to Riichi City before 23:59 (UTC+9) on 2025/03/09 (Sun.).
※ Eligible players will receive a tournament invitation via in-app email.
※ Players advancing to the knockout stage will be notified by our official team via their linked email.

[Schedule]
◆ Preliminary Stage ◆
• Preliminary Stage 1: 2025/03/10 (Mon.) 19:00 - 2025/03/16 (Sun.) 23:59 (UTC+9)
• Preliminary Stage 2: 2025/03/17 (Mon.) 19:00 - 2025/03/23 (Sun.) 23:59 (UTC+9)
• Preliminary Stage 3: 2025/03/24 (Mon.) 19:00 - 2025/03/30 (Sun.) 23:59 (UTC+9)
• Preliminary Stage 4: 2025/03/31 (Mon.) 19:00 - 2025/04/06 (Sun.) 23:59 (UTC+9)

◆ Knockout Stage ◆
• Quarter-Finals: Starts on 2025/04/11 (Fri.) 20:00 (UTC+9)
• Semi-Finals: Starts on 2025/04/12 (Sat.) 20:00 (UTC+9)
• Final: Starts on 2025/04/13 (Sun.) 20:00 (UTC+9)

[Tournament Details]
◆ Preliminary Stage ◆
• During each phase, eligible players participate by joining 4P Hanchan Ranked Matches (Galaxy).
• Players will be ranked based on the highest total points accumulated in five consecutive matches on the corresponding stage rankings. The top eight players from each ranking will advance to the quarter-finals. If a player withdraws, the vacant position will be offered to the player next in line, continuing until a total of 32 players advance.
★ Navigate through: Homepage > Ranked Match > 4P > Galaxy > Hanchan

• After the preliminary stage ends, all the rankings will remain available for 48 hours for players to review.
• Post-advancement match results will not be factored into the corresponding rankings. For example, if a player has secured a spot during the preliminary stage 1, their match results achieved in the stage 2 or 3 will not be factored into the corresponding stage rankings.
• After each phase is completed, an official email will be sent from event@mahjong-jp.com to the top 8 players on the corresponding ranking at their linked email address. These players must reply within 24 hours to confirm their participation in the quarter-finals to ensure their full qualification and eligibility for tournament rewards.
• In addition to the 32 advancing players, the top 10 players with the highest total points from five consecutive matches across all four preliminary stages will receive a substitute invitation for the quarter-finals.

※ Failure to reply to the confirmation email will result in both qualification and rewards being transferred to the player next in line. Once confirmed, players will receive a quarter-final invitation via in-app email before the match starts.
※ Confirmed players must join all subsequent matches and are prohibited from withdrawing. Failure to comply will result in the forfeiture of both qualification and rewards.

◆ Knockout Stage ◆
Players who have advanced to this stage can join matches by entering the corresponding IDs on the Custom Tournament page.
★ Navigate through: Homepage > Custom Game > Tournament > Enter ID > Tap the Enter button > Tap the Ready button

<Quarter-Finals>
• Start Time: 2025/04/11 (Fri.) 20:00 (UTC+9)
• ID: 3220436
• During the quarter-finals, the top 32 players will be assigned randomly to eight different tables after joining the tournament via the Custom Tournament page. Participants will compete in four consecutive 4P Hanchan Ranked Matches with the same opponents but with randomly assigned seating.
• The top two players of each table will advance to the semi-finals.
• After all quarter-final matches are completed, the 16 advancing players will receive a semi-final invitation via their linked email.
 • Players ranked 17th to 21st will receive a substitute invitation for the semi-finals.

<Semi-Finals>
• Start Time: 2025/04/12 (Sat.) 20:00 (UTC+9)
• ID: 3647082
• During the semi-finals, the top 16 players will be assigned randomly to four different tables after joining the tournament via the Custom Tournament page. Participants will compete in four consecutive 4P Hanchan Ranked Matches with the same opponents but with randomly assigned seating.
• The one with the highest total points of each table will advance to the final.
• After all semi-final matches are completed, the 4 advancing players will receive a final invitation to the Tenkaichi Table via their linked email.
• Players ranked 5th to 7th will receive a substitute invitation for the final (Tenkaichi Table).

<Final>
• Start Time: 2025/04/13 (Sun.) 20:00 (UTC+9)
• ID: 4968765
• During the final, the top four players will compete in four consecutive 4P Hanchan Ranked Matches, and be ranked based on the highest total points accumulated. The player with the highest total points at the end will be crowned the winner of the third 4P Mahjong Legends!
※ If there is a tie in total points, players will be ranked by the number of times they place first; if they have the same number of times placing first, they will be ranked according to their points achieved in the last Hanchan match.

[Prizes]
<Final>
• 1st: Physical Champion Trophy (4P) x1, Monthly Mascot (180 Days), Lucky Token x50, 50,000 Yen Gift Card, Exclusive Title - Legendary Champion (4P) (365 Days)
• 2nd: Monthly Mascot (30 Days), Lucky Token x30, 30,000 Yen Gift Card x1
• 3rd: Monthly Mascot (30 Days), Lucky Token x20, 20,000 Yen Gift Card x1
• 4th: Monthly Mascot (30 Days), Lucky Token x10, 10,000 Yen Gift Card x1

<Semi-Finals>
• 5th - 16th: Monthly Mascot (30 Days), Lucky Token x10, 1,000 Yen Gift Card x1

<Quarter-Finals>
• 17th - 32nd: Monthly Mascot (30 Days), Lucky Token x5

<Preliminary Stage>
• 1st - 100th in each stage: Coin x5,000, Legendary Gift Mystery Box (Locked) x1

• Participation prize: Participants will receive Legendary Gift Mystery Box (Locked) x1 after completing a total of five 4P Hanchan Ranked Matches (Galaxy) during any preliminary stage.
• Yakuman prize: Participants will receive Lucky Token x1 each time they win with Yakuman.
※ Each participant can only receive the participation prize once and the Yakuman prize (including Counted Yakuman) up to three times.
※ Players will be disqualified and have their prizes forfeited if found engaging in any form of cheating during the tournament.

[Tournament Rules]
◆ Preliminary Stage ◆
Riichi City 4P Ranked Match Rules
※ Please check the in-app Ranked Match page for more details.

◆ Knockout Stage ◆
• 4-Player Hanchan
• Action Time: 5+20s
• Starting Points: 25,000; Kaeshi Points: 30,000 (Oka on)
• Min. Pts to Win: 30,000 (Extension into West allowed)
• Uma: [1st +50, 2nd +10, 3rd -10, 4th -30]
• 3 Red Tiles, Ippatsu, Uradora & Kandora allowed (Reveal Kandora immediately)
• Kuitan & Atozuke allowed
• Tochuu Ryuukyoku allowed (including Kyuushu Kyuuhai, Suufon Renda, Suukaikan, Triple Ron, and Suucha Riichi)
• Tenpai Renchan allowed; No Tobi
• Daiminkan Pao allowed
• Agariyame & Tenpaiyame allowed when the dealer (Parent) finishes in 1st place
• East 1 seating order serves as a tie-breaker: East > South > West > North
※ All rights reserved by Riichi City

[Cheating Behaviors]
• Cheating in any form during the match is strictly prohibited. Violators will face immediate disqualification and a permanent ban from participating in all future official tournaments hosted by Riichi City. While match results will stand, scores achieved by a cheating player will be invalidated.
• The judging panel consists of Riichi City's official team. Any detected cheating behavior or player reports will be taken seriously and thoroughly investigated.

[Withdrawal & Latecomer Policies]
• Failure to provide prior notice and arriving more than 5 minutes late for the quarter-finals, semi-finals or the final will lead to automatic disqualification and a 1-year ban from all future official tournaments hosted by Riichi City. In such cases, a substitute player will be assigned to ensure the match proceeds smoothly.

[Substitution Rules]
• The substitution system ensures fairness and smooth tournament progression by preventing disruptions caused by last-minute absences. Substitutes will be selected and assigned strictly in accordance with the official rules to uphold fairness and integrity.
• Substitutes (10 for the quarter-finals, 5 for the semi-finals, and 3 for the final) will be chosen in descending order based on the scores of all players from the previous stage. 
• Substitutes must remain online before the match begins and tap the Ready button promptly after joining the corresponding Custom Tournament.
• Two hours before the match, the official team will send an email to all participants to confirm the attendance. Players who notify the team that they cannot attend or arrive more than 5 minutes late after the scheduled start time will be disqualified and replaced by a substitute.

[Substitute Rewards]
• Substitutes who arrive and be ready on time on match day, regardless of whether they compete, will receive: Monthly Mascot (10 Days), Lucky Token x1.
• If a substitute competes and successfully advances, they will receive the same qualification and rewards as official participants.

[Live Streaming]
• During the tournament, participants are permitted to live stream their matches, but are expected to implement a minimum 5-minute (300-second) delay to ensure a fair and competitive environment. Violations of this rule will result in disqualification and a 1-year ban from participating in any future official tournaments hosted by Riichi City.

notes.title: （Korea Market only）Information on the integrated service with STOVE
notes.notes:
Information on the integrated service with STOVE of Riichi City Korea(PC) 

Dear Captains
Thank you very much for your support to the Riichi City all the time!

The Korean service of Riichi City has signed an integrated service contract with [SMilegate's STOVE], and the STOVE integrated service will officially launch on January 8, 2025.

Therefore, "Steam" and "Official PC Launcher" services, which are conducting service in Korea on Riichi City, will be terminated on January 8, 2025.

If your existing Riichi City account is linked to your email, you can also play it on STOVE Riichi City without any problems.

After that, for safer account security, it is recommended to proceed with "STOVE Account Linkage", and the STOVE account link method is as follows.

1. Period of account linkage
From the time of announcement to the time of separate announcement

2. STOVE Account Linkage Procedure
①Download and install the STOVE PC client and searching for Riichi City in the store
Download link for STOVE PC client: https://www.onstove.com/ko/download
②On the STOVE client, click the email login button after running Riichi City and log in to an existing account
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42810873/8a98ae3c79bdb45c3c0a3e7b365be750e04b0546.png[/img]
③ Link an existing Riichi City account with a STOVE account
a. Click Settings in the upper right corner of the lobby screen.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42810873/82aec941f7dba86364e44b3d3241472326800b94.png[/img]
b. In [Account] select STOVE Account Link
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42810873/91cea04c85af13467f6e9e51ccf55bc7d860dce6.png[/img]

3. Precautions
① From January 8, 2025, Steam and the official PC Launcher will not be available.
② Data from existing accounts will not be deleted, and will be available via email login from the STOVE client.
③ You can use the game with your existing account only through email login. Please link your account with the available mail.

We deeply apologize for the inconvenience caused to the captains due to this adjustment.

To compensate for this, we prepared [Lucky Token×1] to the captains who successfully logged in with the STOVE platform until Feb. 15, 2025 and linked with the STOVE account

(Note: The gift can only be received by achieving D3 for 3P or 4P.)

Update Notice (10/30)

There will be an update scheduled on 10/30 from 11:00 to 17:00 (UTC+9). Please note that the duration is subject to change without prior notice.
※ You can still access the game as normal during the update.

1. Introducing the Online Assistant System
To ensure players receive timely assistance and support, we will introduce a new Online Assistant system available in the Settings - Feedback - Q&A section, which provides:
(1) FAQ Support
* In the FAQ section,players can type or choose from preset keywords and questions for quick answers.
(2) Live Assistant Support
* In the Live Assistant section,eligible players can connect and chat with a live assistant for more detailed and real-time support.
※ Live assistant hours: Monday to Friday 11:00-20:00 (UTC+9)

2. EX Furinkazan Support Task Optimizations

After the update, players can claim all Support Task rewards at once by tapping any "Claim" button within the Support Tasks.
※ Weekly and Monthly Support Task rewards will still need to be claimed separately.

3. The following new Tiles will be available in the Shop - Exchange - Voucher Store. Don't miss out!
◆ Tiles - Deep Green
◆ Tiles - Orchid
◆ Tiles - Deep Blue

4. Daily Mission Optimizations
Starting from 05:00 (UTC+9) on October 31, Daily Missions will refresh randomly, including some new missions, while the total number of missions required for completion will remain unchanged.

5. Adding a new Reset button for editing the Friendly Match rules.

6. Visual improvements on the match loading screen and Mangan animations.

7. After the update, if a player logs back into their account before the deletion process is complete, their account deletion request (including those made before the update) will be canceled automatically.

8. Other optimizations.

notes.title: 3P Mahjong Legends Tenkaichi Tournament
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42810873/ce00c83693e5f5527cca966b3ad05caf61ef2849.png[/img]
Calling all skilled players who have achieved 7th Dan or above in 3P Ranked Matches and linked their emails!
Get ready for the 2024 Mahjong Legends and shine on the grand stage! 

【Overview】
The 2nd 3P Mahjong Legends is an official match open to players who have achieved 7th Dan or above in 3P Ranked Matches. The Mahjong Legends consists of a preliminary stage and a knockout stage, and the winner will be determined according to the process below. 

◆Preliminary Stage◆
Table: 3P Ranked Match - Galaxy - Hanchan
Preliminary Stage 1 + Preliminary Stage 2 + Preliminary Stage 3
*The top 9 players from each preliminary stage will advance.

◆Knockout Stage◆
Table: Custom Game - Custom Tournament
Quarter-Finals: The top 9 players will advance.
Semi-Finals: The top 3 players will advance.
Final: The player with the highest points will be crowned the champion.
※All matches are 3P Hanchans.

【Eligibility】
Participants must reach 7th Dan or above in 3P Ranked Matches and have their emails linked to Riichi City before 23:59 (UTC+9) on 2024/10/13 (Sun.).
※Eligible players will receive a tournament invitation via in-app email. 

【Schedule】
◆Preliminary Stage◆
・Preliminary Stage 1:
2024/10/14 (Mon.) 19:00 - 2024/10/20 (Sun.) 23:59 (UTC+9)
・Preliminary Stage 2:
2024/10/21 (Mon.) 19:00 - 2024/10/27 (Sun.) 23:59 (UTC+9)
・Preliminary Stage 3:
2024/10/28 (Mon.) 19:00 - 2024/11/03 (Sun.) 23:59 (UTC+9)

◆Knockout Stage◆
・Quarter-Finals: 2024/11/08 (Fri.) 19:00 - 22:00 (UTC+9)
・Semi-Finals: 2024/11/09 (Sat.) 19:00 - 22:00 (UTC+9)
・Final: 2024/11/10 (Sun.) 19:00 - 23:00 (UTC+9) 

【Tournament Details】
◆Preliminary Stage◆
・During each phase, eligible players participate in the tournament by joining 3P Hanchan Ranked Matches (Galaxy).
・Players will be ranked based on the highest total points accumulated in eight consecutive matches on the corresponding stage rankings. The top 9 players from each ranking will advance to the quarter-finals. If a player withdraws, the vacant position will be offered to the player next in line.
★Navigate through: Homepage > Ranked Match > 3P > Galaxy > Hanchan 

・After the preliminary stage ends, all the rankings will remain available for 48 hours for players to review.
・Post-advancement match results will not be factored into the corresponding rankings. For example, if a player has secured a spot during the preliminary stage 1, their match results achieved in the stage 2 and 3 will not be factored into the corresponding stage rankings.
・After a stage is completed, an official email will be sent from event@mahjong-jp.com to the top 9 players on each ranking at their linked email address. These players must reply to the email within 24 hours to confirm their participation in the quarter-finals to ensure their full qualification and tournament rewards. 
※Failure to reply to the confirmation email will result in both qualification and rewards being transferred to the player next in line. Once players respond, they will receive a quarter-final invitation via in-app email before the match starts.
※Confirmed players must join all subsequent matches and are prohibited from withdrawing. No further confirmation emails will be sent afterwards. 

◆Knockout Stage◆
During this period, players who have advanced to this stage can join matches by entering the corresponding IDs on the Custom Tournament page.
★Navigate through: Homepage > Custom Game > Tournament > Enter ID > Tap the Enter button > Tap the Ready button 

[Quarter-Finals]
・Schedule: 2024/11/08 (Fri.) 19:00 - 22:00 (UTC+9)
・ID: 3220436
・During the quarter-finals, the top 27 players will be assigned randomly to 9 different tables after joining the tournament via the Custom Tournament page. Participants will compete in four consecutive 3P Hanchan Ranked Matches with the same opponents but with randomly assigned seating.
・The one with the highest total points of each table will advance to the semi-finals.
・After all quarter-final matches are completed, the 9 advancing players will receive a semi-final invitation via in-app email. 

[Semi-Finals]
・Schedule: 2024/11/09 (Sat.) 19:00 - 22:00 (UTC+9)
・ID: 3647082
・During the semi-finals, the top 9 players will be assigned randomly to 3 different tables after joining the tournament via the Custom Tournament page. Participants will compete in four consecutive 3P Hanchan Ranked Matches with the same opponents but with randomly assigned seating.
・The one with the highest total points of each table will advance to the final.
・After all semi-final matches are completed, the 3 advancing players will receive a final invitation to the Tenkaichi Table via in-app email. 

[Final]
・Schedule: 2024/11/10 (Sun.) 19:00 - 23:00 (UTC+9)
・ID: 4968765
・During the final, the top 3 players will compete in 6 consecutive 3P Hanchan Ranked Matches, and be ranked based on the highest total points accumulated.
・The player with the highest total points at the end will be crowned the winner of the 2nd Mahjong Legends Tenkaichi Tournament (3P) in 2024!
※If there is a tie in total points, players will be ranked by the number of times they place first; if they have the same number of times placing first, they will be ranked according to their points achieved in the last Hanchan match.

【Prizes】
[Final]
・1st: Physical Champion Trophy (3P) x1, Monthly Mascot (180 Days), Lucky Token x50, 30,000 Yen Gift Card, Exclusive Title - Legendary Champion (3P) (365 Days)
・2nd: Monthly Mascot (30 Days), Lucky Token x30, 20,000 Yen Gift Card x1
・3rd: Monthly Mascot (30 Days), Lucky Token x20, 10,000 Yen Gift Card x1

[Semi-Finals]
・4th - 9th: Monthly Mascot (30 Days), Lucky Token x10, 1,000 Yen Gift Card x1

[Quarter-Finals]
・10th - 27th: Monthly Mascot (30 Days), Lucky Token x5

[Preliminary Stage]
・1st - 100th in each stage: Coin x5,000, Legendary Gift Mystery Box (Locked) x1 

・Participation prize: Participants will receive Legendary Gift Mystery Box (Locked) x1 after completing a total of eight 3P Hanchan Ranked Matches (Galaxy) during any preliminary stage.
・Yakuman prize: Participants will receive Lucky Token x1 each time they win with Yakuman. 
※Each participant can only receive the participation prize once and the Yakuman prize (including Counted Yakuman) up to three times.
※Players will be disqualified and have their prizes forfeited if found engaging in any form of cheating during the tournament. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42810873/472711c1667bb2de583d74834071162ea5281ea3.png[/img]
【Tournament Rules】
◆Preliminary Stage◆
Riichi City 3P Ranked Match Rules
※Please check the in-app Ranked Match page for more details. 

◆Knockout Stage◆
• Hanchan
• Action Time: 5+20s
• Starting Points: 35,000
• Kaeshi Points: 40,000 (No Oka)
• Min. Pts to Win: 40,000 (Extension into West allowed)
• Uma: [1st +15, 2nd ±0, 3rd -15]
• 2 Red Tiles, Ippatsu, Uradora & Kandora allowed
• Reveal Kandora immediately
• Kuitan & Atozuke allowed
• Tochuu Ryuukyoku allowed (including Kyuushu Kyuuhai and Suukaikan)
• Tenpai Renchan & Tobi allowed
• Agariyame & Tenpaiyame allowed when the dealer (Parent) finishes in 1st place
• If there is a tie at the end of the match, the rankings will be determined based on the seating order in the East 1 round: East > South > West > North
※All rights reserved by Riichi City

【Cheating Behaviors】
・Cheating in any form during the match is strictly prohibited. Violators will face immediate disqualification and a permanent ban from participating in all future official tournaments hosted by Riichi City. While match results will stand, scores achieved by a cheating player will be invalidated.
・The judging panel consists of Riichi City's official team and esteemed professional mahjong players from Japan. Any detected cheating behavior or player reports will be taken seriously and thoroughly investigated. 

【Withdrawal & Latecomer Policies】
・Failure to notify and arriving more than 5 minutes late for the quarter-finals, semi-finals or the final will lead to automatic disqualification and a 1-year ban from participating in all future official tournaments hosted by Riichi City. In such cases, an AI player will substitute for the latecomer to ensure the match progresses, but its scores will not be factored into the final rankings. 

【Live Streaming】
・During the tournament, participants are permitted to live stream their matches, but are expected to implement a minimum 5-minute (300-second) delay to ensure a fair and competitive environment. Violations of this rule will result in disqualification and a 1-year ban from participating in any future official tournaments hosted by Riichi City.

notes.title: Update Notice (07/24)
notes.notes:
Update Notice (07/24)

There will be an update scheduled on 07/24 from 17:00 to 23:00 (UTC+9). Please note that the duration is subject to change without prior notice.
※Players can still access the game as normal during the update.

1. Special Yakuman Animations - Yakuman Goddesses Are Available Soon!
The Yakuman Goddesses, spirits representing the world's ten great wills, are deeply connected to human civilization. They appear in female forms due to people's expectations. Whenever a player achieves a Yakuman, they manifest to reveal a splendid and magical scene to everyone in the match.

※When a Yakuman is achieved, the Winning Animation will be skipped, and the Yakuman Animation will play immediately.

※To ensure smooth Yakuman Animations, we recommend the following system specifications to play the game:
Android: 8-core processor + 6GB of RAM
iOS: 3GB of RAM

2. The cover of Weekly Yakuman Rankings will be upgraded.

3.Character Image Upgrade Coming in August: Isshiki Seibi (Default Outfit)
※To make this transformation even sweeter, Seibi has prepared a special surprise for each Captain. Don't miss out on the 2.5th anniversary of Riichi City and join Seibi for the festivities!

4. Other optimizations.

notes.title: Update Notice (05/15)
notes.notes:
Update Notice (05/15)

There will be an update scheduled on 05/15 from 17:00 to 23:00 (UTC+9). Please note that the duration is subject to change without prior notice.
 ※You can still access the game as normal during the update.

1. Radiance Dreams S2 Live Soon.
Radiance Dreams S2 will be live officially after the end of maintenance on 2024/05/15. Players can cheer for their favorite characters to higher rankings on the event page. After the event, the Top Pick (the character who holds the top spot) will receive an exclusive outfit designed by the Riichi City official team.
* During the event, players can receive Hearts by completing event tasks.
* Players can cheer for characters and increase their Radiance Points by sending Hearts, fan club gifts, bonding gifts, or giving likes, and help them rise to the top of Character Rankings!
* Players can fulfill characters' Daily Wishes and win extra Radiance Points.
* Players can also increase their Fan Levels by cheering for a character and unlock various rewards, including Avatar Frame - Radiant Stage, Tiles - Radiant Stage, Gift Mystery Boxes, and more!
* During the event, the top 100 players on any character's Fan Rankings will have a chance to receive: Avatar Frame - Sunrise Overture, Avatar Frame (Animated) - Sunrise Overture (Champ), Avatar Frame - Verdant Ballad, or Avatar Frame (Animated) - Verdant Ballad (Champ)!

※ Please see the event page for more details.
Event duration: the end of maintenance on 2024/05/15 (Wed.) - 2024/05/27 (Mon.) 04:59 (UTC+9)

2. New Setting: Block Characters' Winning Animations.
Players can tap Settings > General > Privacy and turn this option on/off. With this option on, only the default Winning Animations of the corresponding characters will be played for wins of Mangan or above.
※You will need to reconfigure this setting when logging in from different devices.

3. Volume setting optimization.
The overall volume feature will be optimized, so after the update, players will need to readjust their volume settings for the best experience.

4. Adjustments on preventing text overflow in awakening voice lines, improving the character awakening experience.

5. New Wareme setting in Custom Tournaments.

6. Other optimizations.

notes.title: Update Notice (09.19)
notes.notes:
Update Notice (09.19)

There will be an update scheduled on 09.19. Check out the details below!

1. To ensure a better and smoother gaming experience, Riichi City's server will be offline for maintenance starting from 03:00 (UTC+9) on 2023/09/20.The maintenance is expected to last approximately 6 hours, although the duration is subject to change. 
During the maintenance period, players will be unable to log in to the game. We kindly ask you to plan your gaming activities accordingly to avoid any potential disruptions.
After the maintenance ends, players who have reached D3 Dan in any Ranked Match before the maintenance will receive a Lucky Token as compensation via in-app email. We apologize for any inconvenience caused and sincerely appreciate your understanding.

2. Friendly Match optimizations,
- Rule optimizations.

You are cordially invited to join the Live Streamers Christmas Battle. It would be a pleasure to meet you in the event!
